## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core` → `Services` → `Api`)

---

### Root Cause (1 issue)

**`Services.csproj`** — Missing NuGet package reference to `Newtonsoft.Json`

| Error | Location | Message |
|-------|----------|---------|
| CS0246 | `UserService.cs(2,7)` | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | `UserService.cs(3,7)` | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | `UserService.cs(22,19)` | `'JObject'` type not found |

The code uses `using Newtonsoft.Json;` and `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;` (lines 2–3) and instantiates a `JObject` (line 22), but `Services.csproj` has **no `<PackageReference>` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**.

### Cascading Failure

**`Api.csproj`** — Did not compile because it depends on `Services.csproj` via `<ProjectReference>`. The build log shows: *"Target 'Build' skipped. Previously built unsuccessfully."* No errors originate from `Api` itself.

**`Core.csproj`** — Built successfully (no errors).

---

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single change resolves all 3 compiler errors and unblocks the `Api` project build.
